CustomField.description: Whether the loan can be funded: no open conditions, no outstanding required documents, an approved amount, and a closing date.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows Ready to fund, or what is still missing.
CustomField.label: Funding Readiness
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(Open_Approval_Conditions__c + Open_Closing_Conditions__c = 0, Required_Documents_Outstanding__c = 0, NOT(ISBLANK(Approved_Amount__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Closing_Date__c))), "Ready to fund", "Not ready: " & IF(Open_Approval_Conditions__c + Open_Closing_Conditions__c > 0, TEXT(Open_Approval_Conditions__c + Open_Closing_Conditions__c) & " open condition(s). ", "") & IF(Required_Documents_Outstanding__c > 0, TEXT(Required_Documents_Outstanding__c) & " required document(s) outstanding. ", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Approved_Amount__c), "No approved amount. ", "") & IF(ISBLANK(Closing_Date__c), "No closing date.", "") )
